الأدعية

أدعية من القرآن والسنة

اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ وَعَافِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ، وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهُ، وَوَسِّعْ مُدْخَلَهُ، وَاغْسِلْهُ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ، وَنَقِّهِ مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا نَقَّيْتَ الثَّوْبَ الْأَبْيَضَ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ

Allāhumma-ghfir lahu warhamhu wa ʿāfihi waʿfu ʿanhu, wa akrim nuzulahu, wa wassiʿ mudkhalahu, waghsilhu bil-māʾi wath-thalji wal-barad, wa naqqihi minal-khaṭāyā kamā naqqayta-th-thawb al-abyaḍ min ad-danas

O Allah, forgive him, have mercy on him, grant him well-being, pardon him, honor his arrival, expand his entrance, wash him with water, snow and hail, and cleanse him of sins as You cleanse a white garment of dirt

Sahih Muslim 963

اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ قَبْرَهُ رَوْضَةً مِنْ رِيَاضِ الْجَنَّةِ، وَلَا تَجْعَلْهُ حُفْرَةً مِنْ حُفَرِ النَّارِ

Allāhumma-jʿal qabrahu rawḍatan min riyāḍ al-jannah, wa lā tajʿalhu ḥufratan min ḥufar an-nār

O Allah, make his grave a garden from the gardens of Paradise, and do not make it a pit from the pits of Hell

At-Tirmidhi

اللَّهُمَّ أَبْدِلْهُ دَاراً خَيْراً مِنْ دَارِهِ، وَأَهْلاً خَيْراً مِنْ أَهْلِهِ، وَأَدْخِلْهُ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَمِنْ عَذَابِ النَّارِ

Allāhumma abdilhu dāran khayran min dārihi, wa ahlan khayran min ahlihi, wa adkhilhu-l-jannah wa aʿidhhu min ʿadhāb al-qabr wa min ʿadhāb an-nār

O Allah, give him a better home than his home, and better family than his family, and admit him to Paradise and protect him from the punishment of the grave and the punishment of Hell

Sahih Muslim 963

اللَّهُمَّ ثَبِّتْهُ عَلَى الْقَوْلِ الثَّابِتِ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ

Allāhumma thabbit-hu ʿalā-l-qawli-th-thābiti fil-ḥayāti-d-dunyā wa fil-ākhirah

O Allah, make him firm on the word of truth in this life and in the Hereafter

Sahih al-Bukhari 1362
